annotation.title_clean: D.C. Law 25-168. Autonomous Vehicle Testing Permit Requirement Temporary Amendment Act of 2024
annotation.title_en: D.C. Law 25-168. Autonomous Vehicle Testing Permit Requirement Temporary Amendment Act of 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of the District of Columbia
annotation.venue: D.C. Law Library / Council of the District of Columbia
annotation.summary_en: Temporary D.C. act amending the Autonomous Vehicle Act of 2012 to bar testing or operating autonomous vehicles on District roads without an AV testing permit. Until a permit application exists, testers must have a test operator in the vehicle and give DDOT 10 business days' notice. It expires 225 days after taking effect.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits testing or operating AVs on District roads without an AV testing permit.
Interim exception, while no permit application exists, requires a test operator physically present who performs or can take over the dynamic driving task.
Requires electronic notice to DDOT at least 10 business days before testing, covering vehicle numbers, models, operator training, locations and time period.
Repeals Section 3e of the Autonomous Vehicle Act and extends Section 3f(a)(1) to any person or entity.
Takes effect after Mayoral approval and 30-day congressional review; expires 225 days after taking effect.
